local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local t=.2
local held=0
local elapsed=0
local struck=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt
 if input.isMouseButtonPressed(1) then held=held+dt else held=0 end
 if held>=2 then print('VilverinContinue recovery held two seconds') end
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during actual Skeleton response baseline')
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4bb63))
 if not target or not target:isValid() then return end
 local origin=self.position+util.vector3(0,0,65)
 local point=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,50)
 local dv=point-origin;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*dv.x-f.x*dv.y,f.x*dv.x+f.y*dv.y)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(dv.z,math.sqrt(dv.x*dv.x+dv.y*dv.y))
 if dv:length()>=700 then print('VilverinContinue skeleton range ready') end
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue recovery aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5)))))
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current
 local eq={{}}
 for slot,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(target)) do eq[#eq+1]=tostring(slot)..':'..tostring(item.recordId) end
 table.sort(eq)
 local arrows=0
 for _,item in ipairs(Actor.inventory(target):getAll()) do if tostring(item.recordId)=='FormId:0x1017829' then arrows=arrows+item.count end end
 print('VilverinContinue recovery sample simulation='..core.getSimulationTime()..' playerHealth='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' skeletonHealth='..hp..' distance='..dv:length()..' stance='..Actor.getStance(target)..' equipment='..table.concat(eq,',')..' arrows='..arrows)
 if hp<20 and not struck then struck=elapsed end
 if struck and elapsed-struck>=5 then print('VilverinContinue skeleton response observation complete') end
end}}}}
